faq.q: Where are the NYE 2025 fireworks in Marbella?
faq.a: The main fireworks display is launched from Puerto Banús, just off the breakwater near the marina entrance. The show typically starts at midnight and lasts 10-15 minutes. From a boat, you'll have an unobstructed view of the sky above La Concha and the Golden Mile, with the marina lights reflecting on the water.

faq.q: How far from the fireworks should my boat anchor?
faq.a: For safety and the best view, anchor 200-400 metres off the breakwater. This keeps you clear of the exclusion zone and lets you see the full arc of the display without craning your neck. Our skippers know the exact coordinates and will position you for the optimal experience.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks on board?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring your own food and extra drinks. All our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks as standard. For a special celebration, consider adding a private caterer — just let us know when booking.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on NYE?
faq.a: If the port closes or the fireworks are cancelled due to weather, we'll reschedule your charter to another date or offer a full refund. Our skipper monitors forecasts closely and will advise you 24 hours before departure. In good weather, the sea is usually calm in the bay.

faq.q: How many people can fit on a boat for the fireworks?
faq.a: Capacity ranges from 5 to 12 passengers depending on the boat. For groups up to 9, the Astondoa 40 is ideal; for 10-12, choose the Azimut 58 Flybridge or the Mangusta 80. All boats are certified for their passenger numbers and include all safety equipment.

faq.q: How much does it cost to rent a boat for NYE in Marbella?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, which covers the fireworks window. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

faq.q: When should I book my NYE boat in Marbella?
faq.a: Book as early as possible — NYE is our busiest night. We recommend reserving by 15 December to secure your preferred boat and slot. A 50% deposit confirms the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. Last-minute bookings may be possible, but availability is limited.

faq.q: Can we watch the fireworks from a boat in other marinas?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is the epicentre of the Marbella NYE fireworks, but some smaller displays occur in Estepona and Sotogrande. If you prefer a quieter spot, we can arrange a charter to anchor off Cabopino or Cala del Faro — but the main event is best viewed from Banús.

data.body_html:
New Year's Eve in Marbella is a spectacle of light, glamour, and celebration — and the best seat in the house is on the water. Watching the new year's eve boat fireworks marbella from a private charter in Puerto Banús gives you an uninterrupted view of the sky over La Concha, with the marina's glittering yachts as your backdrop. Whether you're after a sleek 12.5-metre flybridge or a 24-metre superyacht, we've got the perfect vessel for your NYE 2025 celebration.

Why Watch NYE Fireworks from a Boat in Marbella?

On land, the Puerto Banús promenade is packed shoulder-to-shoulder by 11:30 PM. From a boat, you get space, comfort, and a front-row view. The fireworks launch from the breakwater at the marina entrance, so anchoring 200-400 metres off gives you a perfect angle. Plus, you avoid the crowds and the cold — our boats are fully equipped with heating, blankets, and a bar stocked with cava.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). So you can focus on the countdown, not the logistics. For a truly memorable night, consider our boat rental Marbella options tailored to NYE.

Top Viewing Spots for the Fireworks

Our skippers know the exact coordinates for the best view. Here are the prime anchoring spots:

  • Off the breakwater (200m): The classic spot — directly in front of the launch site, with the full display overhead.
  • Between Puerto Banús and Río Verde: Slightly further out, but still a clear sightline, with less boat traffic.
  • Cala del Faro: A quieter cove just south of Banús — ideal if you want a more intimate setting with a distant view.

Each spot is within 10-15 minutes of the marina, so you'll have plenty of time to toast at midnight and still get back to port for after-parties.

For couples or small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is a cosy choice. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 with its free jet ski adds an extra thrill — you can even ride the jet ski during the fireworks (with appropriate safety gear, of course).

What's Included in Your NYE Charter

All our NYE charters include:

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no hidden costs

You're welcome to bring your own food and decorations. Many guests bring party hats, balloons, and a portable speaker — just keep it respectful of other boats.

How to Book Your NYE Boat

Booking is simple. Visit our main page to see the full fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on boats not listed above. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For Tier B and other yachts, we'll send a personalised quote within hours.

We recommend booking by 15 December 2025 to secure your preferred boat. A 50% deposit confirms the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. If the port closes or fireworks are cancelled due to weather, we'll reschedule or refund in full.

Other NYE Boat Ideas Beyond the Fireworks

If you want to extend your celebration, consider a longer charter that includes a sunset cruise along the coast to Estepona or Sotogrande before returning for the fireworks. Our NYE package can be customised with a private chef, DJ, or even a fireworks display of your own (subject to permits).

For those who prefer a daytime celebration, a midday cruise to Cabopino is a great way to start the day — then return to port for the evening festivities. The choice is yours.
